name: ADOPTED_FROM
description: An adoption origin: the source was adopted from the target.
target_description: The person, organization, or place from which adoption occurred.
constraints: Acquisition or movement alone does not establish adoption.

name: BORROWED_FROM
description: The source was borrowed from the target lender or source.
target_description: The person or organization that lent or supplied the item.
constraints: Possession, custody, or location alone does not establish borrowing.
A borrower is not thereby an owner.

name: CARED_FOR_BY
description: The source receives care from the target.
target_description: The person or organization providing care.
constraints: Care does not establish ownership or physical custody.

name: COPIED_BY
description: The source was copied, duplicated, fitted, or prepared by the target service provider.
source_description: The copied, duplicated, fitted, or prepared item.
target_description: The person, shop, or organization that performed the service.
constraints: Copying or fitting does not establish purchase, ownership, custody, or repair.
The service provider is not necessarily the item's current location.

name: GIFTED_BY
description: The source was given as a gift by the target.
target_description: The person or organization that gave the gift.
constraints: A recommendation, purchase, or transfer of custody alone does not establish a gift.

name: HELD_BY
description: The target holds or has custody of the source.
source_description: The item being held or kept in custody.
target_description: The custodian, such as a person or organizational custody point.
constraints: Custody does not establish ownership, a loan, or purchase.
A general location question need not uniquely specify custody.

name: ISSUED_BY
description: The source was issued by the target authority or issuer.
source_description: The issued document, credential, or other issued item.
constraints: The issuer is not necessarily the issue location, holder, or renewal date.

name: LOCATED_AT
description: The source is physically located at the target place.
constraints: Location alone does not establish custody, ownership, storage purpose, or an activity at that place.
Location and storage meanings may overlap; do not assume a unique storage label from a general location question.

name: PURCHASED_AT
description: The source was purchased at the target venue or outlet.
constraints: This is the purchase location, not the purchaser or the item's later location.

name: RECOMMENDED_BY
description: The source was recommended by the target.
target_description: The person or organization making the recommendation.
constraints: Mentioning an entity does not necessarily recommend it.
A recommendation does not establish purchase, ownership, or custody.

name: REPAIRED_AT
description: The source has a repair activity at the target venue.
source_description: The item undergoing or associated with repair.
constraints: This is the repair location, not necessarily the repairer.
The label alone does not establish that repair is completed or the item is still there.

name: REPAIRED_BY
description: The target carries out repair work on the source.
target_description: The person or organization performing repair.
constraints: This is the repairer, not necessarily the repair location or owner.
The label alone does not establish completed repair.

name: SIGNED_WITH
description: The source agreement, contract, or document was signed with the target counterparty.
source_description: The signed agreement, contract, or document.
target_description: The person or organization that is the signing counterparty.
constraints: A counterparty is not a signing location, witness, custodian, or issuer.
Mentioning a person or organization in a document does not establish that it signed the agreement.

name: STORED_IN
description: The source is kept in the target storage place or container.
constraints: A storage location does not identify an owner or custodian.
Storage and physical location overlap; neither label is universally interchangeable with the other.
